text: UN experts estimated that M23 rebels made $800,000 a month from the coltan trade in Rubaya, in eastern DR Congo.

source.name: UN Security Council, Group of Experts on the DR Congo: Midterm report (S/2024/969)
source.quote: AFC/M23 thus collected at least $800,000 monthly from the taxation of coltan production and trade in Rubaya.

additionalSources.name: Global Witness: New investigation suggests EU trader Traxys buys conflict minerals from DRC
additionalSources.quote: According to UN experts the ore trade has provided M23 a revenue estimated at US$800,000 per month.
